text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to authorize the installation of an accessible parking space on the west side of Embla Street, north of Barber Greene Road. The proposed accessible parking space will provide safe and convenient curb side access for a resident on this street and will not negatively impact the flow of traffic.

North York Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible parking space to operate at all times on the west side of Embla Street, between a point 25 metres north of Barber Greene Road and a point 5.5 metres further north.
